subject: bio
title: Transport and Gas Exchange
subtitle: Transport and Gas Exchange with mechanism-focused explanation and exam-linked examples.
concept: Transport systems overcome diffusion limits in multicellular organisms by moving materials over long distances quickly. Specialized tissues and pressure gradients enable controlled bulk flow.
In plants, xylem and phloem perform different transport roles. In mammals, blood circulation and ventilation work together to deliver oxygen and remove carbon dioxide.
Gas exchange surfaces are designed for diffusion efficiency: large surface area, short diffusion pathway, and maintained concentration gradients.
